trap.label: which/who
trap.wrong: The book who I bought is great.
trap.right: The book which I bought is great.
trap.why: Em português "que" serve para pessoas e coisas. Em inglês, who é para pessoas e which para coisas.

mcq.q: Em qual frase that é impossível?

opts: Mr. Lee, who is kind, helped.
The man who is kind helped.
Mr. Lee, that is kind, helped.
Rio which is hot is lively.
Rio, which is hot, is lively.
Rio, that is hot, is lively.

fix.wrong: The cake who I made is gone.
fix.right: The cake which I made is gone.

fix.wrong: Paris, that is beautiful, is big.
fix.right: Paris, which is beautiful, is big.

fix.wrong: The man whose his car was stolen called.
fix.right: The man whose car was stolen called.

rewrite.prompt: Una com whose: “I met a boy. His dog is huge.”
rewrite.answer: I met a boy whose dog is huge.

rewrite.prompt: Una com vírgulas: “Anna is my cousin. She lives in Paris.” (who)
rewrite.answer: Anna, who lives in Paris, is my cousin.

rewrite.prompt: Una com which: “London is huge. It has many parks.”
rewrite.answer: London, which has many parks, is huge.
